name: run_shortcut
description: Run a saved automation shortcut by name.

name.description: Name of the shortcut e.g. 'morning routine', 'bedtime', 'leaving home'.

name: create_routine
description: Create a new automation routine with a trigger and actions.

trigger.description: When to run e.g. 'every weekday at 7am', 'when I arrive home', 'at sunset'.

name: delete_routine
description: Delete an automation routine by name.

name.description: Name of the routine to delete.

name: toggle_routine
description: Enable or disable an automation routine.

enabled.description: True to enable, false to disable.

scene_name.description: Scene name e.g. 'movie night', 'dinner party', 'good morning', 'away'.

name: get_routine_history
description: Check when a routine last ran.
